subject: POC planning: evaluation methods and ownership
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@atlashealth.com>, Atlas Health POC Team <poc@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC planning: evaluation methods and ownership

Hi Sam / Atlas POC team — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock timelines and owners.

Recap (30-min discovery)
- Primary goal: reduce triage time for clinical review by surfacing candidate notes and suggested actions.
- Target flows: inbound patient notes ingestion, assistive summaries for clinicians, and automated triage tags.
- Constraints: PHI sanitization required for any dataset access and production deployment in a VPC.

Proposed evaluation approach (two-track, hybrid):
1) Stage 1 — Offline batch evaluation (1 week)
   - Purpose: fast model selection and rubric tuning against historical annotated set.
   - Inputs: sanitized sample of 2k notes (provided by Atlas), grading rubric (see attachment).
   - Output: top 2 model candidates and per-case scoring.
2) Stage 2 — Live shadowing (2 weeks)
   - Purpose: validate performance on real traffic, measure latency/throughput and user-facing regressions.
   - Execution: non-blocking shadow of model outputs into clinician workflow (no auto-actions).
   - Metrics: precision@K, false positive rate, latency P95, and cost per 1k tokens.

Success criteria (suggested):
- Offline: aggregate rubric score >= 0.78 and fewer than 8% critical failures on sample set.
- Shadow: precision >= 0.82 on triage tags AND clinician-reported helpfulness >= 4/5 in survey.

Ownership (proposed):
- Naomi Feldman (me) — success criteria, trial scope, and stakeholder coordination.
- Marissa Cole — eval orchestration, grading runs, and report.
- Karthik Iyer — infra, inference config, and deployment for shadowing.

Immediate asks for Atlas:
1) Confirm preferred evaluation track (offline-first hybrid as proposed or fully live shadow).
2) Provide a sanitized sample (2k notes) and agreed delivery date.
3) Nominate a technical contact to coordinate dataset access and test keys.
4) Confirm any procurement/DocuSign timelines for trial (if needed).

I've attached a draft POC evaluation matrix (poc-eval-matrix.xlsx) and linked a timeline folder. If we agree, I'd like to kick Stage 1 next Monday (9/20) and start shadowing the following week.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: poc-eval-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@atlashealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Atlas Health POC Team <poc@atlashealth.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@atlashealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC planning: evaluation methods and ownership

Thanks Naomi — good summary. A couple quick notes from our side:

- We prefer an initial offline evaluation to narrow down models, but for triage tags we really need live shadowing to capture edge traffic patterns.
- Timeline: we can provide a sanitized sample, but delivery will be dependent on our security review. Estimate ~1 week for sanitized export (target 9/24).
- Olivia (cc'ed) will own data export and access.

A few clarifying Qs:
1) For the offline rubric, can you include a per-label confusion matrix so we can see where models diverge on critical tags?
2) During shadowing, will Redwood supply prod-equivalent keys and a slimmed connector so no PHI leaves our VPC?

If those are doable, we can approve the hybrid path. Can we tentatively schedule a kickoff sync for Mon 9/21?

— Sam
Sam Peterson
Director of Digital Operations | Atlas Health
sam.peterson@atlashealth.com | +1 (212) 555-4433
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@atlashealth.com>, Atlas Health POC Team <poc@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC planning: evaluation methods and ownership

Sam — thanks, all good and yes to your questions. Short answers and an updated plan below.

Q1 (confusion matrix): yes — we will produce per-label precision/recall and confusion matrices as part of the offline report. We'll include per-case examples for any high-impact disagreement.

Q2 (keys & PHI): for shadowing we offer a VPC connector and test API keys that keep inference within your VPC (no outbound PHI). Karthik will outline the connector requirements and necessary IAM roles.

Updated plan (hybrid, tightened):
- Stage 1 (Offline) 
  - Start: as soon as sanitized sample is delivered (target 9/24).
  - Deliverable (3 business days after receipt): model-ranking report, per-label confusion matrices, and recommended top-2 candidates.
- Stage 2 (Shadow)
  - Start: tentatively 9/28 for a 10-business-day run.
  - Deliverable: shadow-run metrics dashboard and clinician feedback summary.

Owners (confirmed):
- Naomi Feldman — success criteria, timelines, communications.
- Marissa Cole — runs + grading automation + final report.
- Karthik Iyer — VPC connector, test keys, and monitoring hooks.

Action items for Atlas (with owners):
- Olivia Chen (Atlas) — deliver sanitized sample (2k notes) and provide S3 path + access by 9/24.
- Atlas security — complete brief connector checklist (Karthik to send) by 9/23.
- Procurement — flag any DocuSign requirements; Naomi to follow if needed.

I've updated the Drive folder with a baseline rubric and a sample confusion-matrix template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4dAtlasPOC

If that timeline looks good we'll lock the kickoff for Mon 9/21 at 10am PT (30m). I can send a calendar invite.

—
Naomi

Subject: Re: POC planning: evaluation methods and ownership

I'll take point on running the offline grading and generating the confusion matrices. Quick checklist from my side:
- Need sanitized sample in agreed CSV format (cols: note_id, raw_text_sanitized, gold_tags, timestamp).
- Please grant my account read access to the S3 bucket or share an export link.
- If possible include a small holdout set (~200 notes) we won't touch until shadowing.

Attachment: data-spec-checklist.md (text) — small checklist I use to validate exports.

Marissa (I'll draft the grading pipeline and post the run notebook to the Drive folder once I have access).
